name: WHO-5 Well-Being Index
citation: WHO Regional Office for Europe, 1998. Public, freely available, non-diagnostic — PRD §10.2.
instructions: Over the last two weeks, how much of the time have each of these been true for you?
items: I have felt cheerful and in good spirits
I have felt calm and relaxed
I have felt active and vigorous
I woke up feeling fresh and rested
My daily life has been filled with things that interest me
